title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1990-04-03
lineage: Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM r500 > Tascam DA-3000 > Flac 16/48
taper: Master Digital Audience Recording by Dave Brotman
source: From the Teddy Ballgame Archive - a reMaster of shnid 142003  Source: Schoeps CMC4 MK21 > Oade Modified Grace Preamp > Pro Link > DAT 48k (Panasonic SV-250) Location: Sec 5 Row J Seat 7

ai_review.summary: Audience tape of an apparently excellent Dead show, but the concert date and set are hotly disputed.
ai_review.review: One reviewer claims the file is mis‑dated and not from April 3 1990, calling it a post‑Brent/Vince era audience recording, while another insists the show really is from that night and praises both the performance and the sound quality. The recording is described as a nice audience capture with clear audio by the supportive reviewer, but no concrete details about song selection or set flow are provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Two conflicting reviews – one 0‑star complaint about metadata and another 4‑star praise of the show and recording – lead to an average rating around the middle of the scale with low confidence due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a nice audience tape with decent clarity; no specific mix issues noted, but the primary criticism concerns incorrect dating rather than sound quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments on set structure; reviewers focus solely on the disputed date and overall impression of the performance.
